title: S02-Based TADPOLE Cognitive-Anchored DARG+DPSL Optimization

relation_sampling.fixed_support: Symmetric positive off-diagonal original GraphLearn edges after epoch 10. Restrict endpoints to outer train.
relation_sampling.forced: Uniform without replacement independently within same/different counts. R1 and R2 take prefixes of the same fold-specific shuffled support pools.
relation_sampling.remainder: Preserve the order of the fold-specific E61 historical sample by target, skip forced duplicates and take the required prefix.
relation_sampling.fallback: If a target has fewer unique support edges than its quota, take all available and fill the shortfall from the historical sample. Record the per-target shortfall and actual support coverage.
relation_sampling.ordering: Use a separate local NumPy RNG stream for a deterministic final shuffle. Keep each unordered edge once with row < col.

freeze: D1 freezes the existing adaptive_gate_logits after the S02 epoch-10 reset and retains its AdamW group membership with no moments or step.

statistics.bootstrap_unit: patient, paired within held-out fold and diagnosis strata
holms: 16 group versus baseline contrasts for each metric and McNemar test
five planned factor contrasts as a separate family
